long: SWAT 4 is a tactical first-person shooter in which players lead a five-member police special-weapons team through hostage and high-risk situations. Emphasizing planning, less-lethal options, and procedure over run-and-gun action, missions reward restraint and arresting suspects. The Gold Edition includes the Stetchkov Syndicate expansion and supports cooperative and competitive multiplayer.
name: SWAT 4: Gold Edition
short: SWAT 4: Gold Edition (Irrational Games 2005, GOG, via Proton)
